body.statement: For a finite ground set \(D\), an integer-valued submodular function \(f:2^D\to\mathbb Z\) supplied by a value oracle can be minimized by a strongly polynomial combinatorial algorithm using a number of oracle calls polynomial in \(|D|\).

source.verbatim_statement: We give a strongly polynomial-time algorithm minimizing a submodular function f given by a value-giving oracle.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the abstract of the CWI repository copy of Schrijver, Journal of Combinatorial Theory Series B 80 (2000), DOI 10.1006/jctb.2000.1989.
